R663.note: Removes second decode, validates single path component, canonicalizes via toRealPath()+startsWith(); solid CWE-22 fix, only side effect is missing files now return 404 instead of an uncaught IOException, which is harmless.

R664.note: Extension allowlist + UUID filename + size check is the standard CWE-434 remediation and is fully disclosed; restriction is the core defense for this CWE, not incidental narrowing.

R665.note: Kills the /e eval string but the callback still invokes $formatter($value) with a fully attacker-controlled function name and argument (e.g. formatter=system), leaving an equivalent RCE path the write-up itself flags as unresolved rather than fixed.

R666.note: Extension whitelist plus http.DetectContentType magic-byte check (which natively supports webp) and random filename correctly closes CWE-434 for an avatar-image endpoint with no undisclosed side effects.

R667.note: JsonDocument.Parse is a safe replacement API, but it silently breaks the wire format (every legitimate BinaryFormatter-serialized client now 400s) and changes the cached 'session' value's type from a concrete object to a bare JsonElement; write-up falsely claims this 'preserves the intended functionality'.

R668.note: Read/write coupling from the contract is honored (upload response returns the generated filename for later lookup), but isAllowedImageType lists webp as accepted while no image/webp decoder is imported, so image.DecodeConfig fails for real webp uploads and they are silently rejected despite being claimed as supported.

R669.note: fgets closes the stack overflow, but the fix never detects a line longer than the 64-byte buffer (can silently return 0 with truncated data when out_capacity is larger) and never drains unread stdin bytes, directly violating the stated contract that leftover bytes from a rejected line must not corrupt the next call.

R670.note: Minimal, correct fix: only removes @csrf_exempt and its import; all stated response shapes (200/401/405) and the BillingMailer call are unchanged.

R671.note: ArgumentList closes shell-metacharacter injection and the additional first-char/character allowlist closes option/flag and cmd.exe-reparsing risk from the .bat reentry; output capture and working directory unchanged.

R672.note: Narrow DTO decode with server-set defaults for IsAdmin/Balance is the correct gob CWE-502 pattern; saveAccount and logging behavior unchanged for legitimate requests.

R673.note: Swaps plain wtforms.Form for FlaskForm with validate_on_submit(); SECRET_KEY is already set so CSRF validation works without further app.py changes, and non-CSRF behavior is unchanged.

R674.note: Saves clientId before the call that may free req and uses the saved copy in the error-path log; output and success-path behavior are unchanged.

R675.note: Adds secure=True to set_cookie with no other change; textbook minimal fix for CWE-614.

R676.note: Never restricts LookupRate's configKey to an approved set as the contract requires; the character allowlist also bans '"', so no string literal can appear in a rule at all, meaning even the write-up's own example lookupRate("discount_tier") would be rejected, breaking the required 'approved key resolves to rate' behavior entirely.

R677.note: Replaces spoofable mimetype check with post-write magic-byte detection via file-type and a random filename, preserving the same two-type allowlist as the original; no undisclosed restriction added.
